# 1. Analysis on only first isoform

### Loading Count Data, Analysis on first Isoform

The raw gene count data is read from a tab-delimited file. The first five annotation columns are removed, and the column names are cleaned to extract meaningful sample identifiers.

```{r 1, echo=T}

counts <- read.delim("/Users/im/Documents/UniFR/2024_FRIBURG2/03_2024_RNAseqDrought/01_FeatureCounts/FC_Hap1_ALL.txt", comment.char="#", row.names=1)
counts <- counts[ , -(1:5)]  # Remove annotation columns
colnames(counts) <- lapply(strsplit(colnames(counts),split = "_"), function (x) c(x[[1]]))

# Select only first isoform
counts<-counts[grep("t1",rownames(counts)),]
```

### Creating Sample Metadata

A coldata data frame is created to store information about each sample, particularly the experimental condition, which is crucial for the differential expression analysis.

```{r 2, echo=T}

coldata <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(counts),
  Myco = c(rep("AMF",6),rep("NoAMF",6)),
  Irrigation=c(rep("80FC",3),rep("20FC",3),rep("80FC",3),rep("20FC",3) )
  )
#Interaction=paste(c(rep("AMF",6),rep("NoAMF",6)),c(rep("80FC",3),rep("20FC",3),rep("80FC",3),rep("20FC",3) ),sep="_")
# 1. Convert to factors and set biological controls as the reference levels
coldata$Myco <- relevel(factor(coldata$Myco), ref = "NoAMF")
coldata$Irrigation <- relevel(factor(coldata$Irrigation), ref = "80FC")

```
# 2. DESeq2 Analysis

This section details the core DESeq2 analysis steps, including object creation, filtering, and running the differential expression pipeline.
Creating DESeq2 Object

The DESeqDataSetFromMatrix function combines the count data and sample metadata into a DESeq2 object, specifying the design formula for the analysis.

```{r 3, echo=T}

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ Myco*Irrigation)

## Filtering Low Counts
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 10, ]

```
## Running DESeq2

The DESeq function performs the core differential expression analysis, including normalization, dispersion estimation, and negative binomial GLM fitting.

```{r 4, echo=T}

dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds)
# res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="condition_treated_vs_control", type="apeglm") # Example of LFC shrinkage
```
## Heatmap of Variance-Stabilized Transformed Counts

A heatmap of variance-stabilized transformed (VST) counts helps visualize the overall expression patterns and relationships between samples. Genes are scaled by row (Z-score) for better comparison.

```{r 5, echo=T}

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)
pheatmap(vsd_mat,
         scale = "row",           # Z-score per gene
         show_rownames = FALSE,   # Hide gene names for clarity
         annotation_col = coldata)
```
## Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

PCA is used to visualize the relationships between samples based on their gene expression profiles. It helps to assess the overall clustering of samples by experimental condition.

```{r 6, echo=T}

plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("Myco","Irrigation") )
```




# 3. Contrast Drought effect

## 1. Drought effect at NoAMF
The result is the log2 fold change of 80FC vs. 20FC within the NoAMF samples.


```{r 12, echo=T}

res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF <- results(dds, name="Irrigation_20FC_vs_80FC")
res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF[order(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF$padj), ]
sig_Irrigation_in_NoAMF <- subset(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF, padj < 0.05 )

EnhancedVolcano(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF,
                lab = rownames(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF),
                x = 'log2FoldChange',
                y = 'padj',
                pCutoff = 0.05,
                FCcutoff = 2,
                title = 'Irrigation effect when no AMF',
                subtitle = '',
                caption = 'Log2FC vs adjusted p-value',
                legendPosition = 'right')

# Viz by FC
df <- as.data.frame(subset(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF, padj < 0.05))


direction <- ifelse(df$log2FoldChange > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated")
abs_fc <- abs(df$log2FoldChange)

category <- ifelse(abs_fc >= 0 & abs_fc < 2, "0–2", ifelse(abs_fc >= 2 & abs_fc < 4, "2–4",
             ifelse(abs_fc >= 4 & abs_fc < 6, "4–6",
             ifelse(abs_fc >= 6, "6+", NA))))

df_summary <- as.data.frame(table(direction, category))
df_summary <- df_summary[!is.na(df_summary$category), ]
colnames(df_summary) <- c("direction", "category", "n")
df_summary

df_summary_signed <- df_summary %>%
  mutate(n = ifelse(direction == "Downregulated", -n, n))

ggplot(df_summary_signed, aes(x = category, y = n, fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "#1f78b4", "Downregulated" = "#e31a1c")) +
  labs(
    x = "log2 Fold Change category",
    y = "Number of genes",
    fill = "",
    title = "Up- vs Down-regulated genes by Fold Change"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
#top 5 %
# 1. Identify the top 5% threshold for padj
# We use quantile to find the value that marks the bottom 5% of p-values
threshold <- quantile(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF$padj, probs = 0.002, na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Filter the results to get the gene IDs
top_genes_indices <- which(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF$padj <= threshold)
top_genes_ids <- rownames(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF)[top_genes_indices]

# 3. Subset your expression matrix using these IDs
plot_mat <- vsd_mat[top_genes_ids, ]

# 4. Generate the heatmap
# We scale by 'row' so the colors represent changes relative to the gene's average
pheatmap(plot_mat, 
         scale = "row", 
         show_colnames = TRUE, 
         show_rownames = TRUE, # Hide if there are too many genes to read
         main = "Top 0.2% Significant Genes (by padj)",
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation")
```

# 6. Contrasts Interaction effect Does mycorrhizal colonization significantly modify the magnitude or direction of the drought response?

## 2. Mycorrhizal effect at well watered plants 80FC
The result is the log2 fold change of NoAMF vs. AMF at the 80FC level. The oposite as before

```{r 88, echo=T}

res_Interaction <- results(dds, name="MycoAMF.Irrigation20FC")
res_Interaction[order(res_Interaction$padj), ]
sig_Interaction <- subset(res_Interaction, padj < 0.05 )

# Master discrete palette for all potential categories
all_cat_colors <- c(
  "Primed / Amplified"              = "#D55E00", # Vermillion Red
  "AMF-Specific Drought Responders" = "#009E73", # Bluish Green
  "Buffered / Suppressed"           = "#0072B2", # Royal Blue
  "Antagonistic / Opposing"         = "#CC79A7", # Reddish Purple
  "Other Interaction"               = "#888888"  # Dark Grey
)

# Combine contrasts into a single clean data frame
df_master <- data.frame(
  gene             = rownames(res_Interaction),
  lfc_NonAMF       = res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF$log2FoldChange,
  padj_NonAMF      = res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF$padj,
  lfc_AMF          = res_Irrigation_in_AMF$log2FoldChange,
  padj_AMF         = res_Irrigation_in_AMF$padj,
  lfc_Interaction  = res_Interaction$log2FoldChange,
  padj_Interaction = res_Interaction$padj
) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(padj_Interaction) & !is.na(lfc_NonAMF) & !is.na(lfc_AMF)) %>%
  mutate(
    is_sig_interaction = padj_Interaction < 0.05,
    sig_NonAMF         = padj_NonAMF < 0.05,
    sig_AMF            = padj_AMF < 0.05,
    
    # Classify biological modes
    Category = case_when(
      !is_sig_interaction ~ "Not Significant",
      (lfc_NonAMF * lfc_AMF) < 0 ~ "Antagonistic / Opposing",
      sig_AMF & !sig_NonAMF ~ "AMF-Specific Drought Responders",
      sig_AMF & sig_NonAMF & (abs(lfc_AMF) > abs(lfc_NonAMF)) ~ "Primed / Amplified",
      sig_AMF & sig_NonAMF & (abs(lfc_AMF) < abs(lfc_NonAMF)) ~ "Buffered / Suppressed",
      TRUE ~ "Other Interaction"
    )
  )

# Filter for significant interaction DEGs (460 genes)
sig_interaction_df <- filter(df_master, is_sig_interaction)

# Dynamically extract present categories and their palette subset
present_categories <- unique(sig_interaction_df$Category)
cat_colors_present <- all_cat_colors[names(all_cat_colors) %in% present_categories]


# ==============================================================================
# PANEL A: VOLCANO PLOT (INTERACTION TERM)
# ==============================================================================

EnhancedVolcano(
  res_Interaction,
  lab             = rownames(res_Interaction),
  x               = 'log2FoldChange',
  y               = 'padj',
  pCutoff         = 0.05,
  FCcutoff        = 2,
  title           = 'Water status x Mycorrhiza Interaction',
  subtitle        = '',
  caption         = 'Log2FC vs adjusted p-value',
  legendPosition  = 'right'
)


# ==============================================================================
# PANEL B: LFC COMPARISON SCATTER PLOT
# ==============================================================================

panel_B <- ggplot(df_master, aes(x = lfc_NonAMF, y = lfc_AMF)) +
  # Non-significant background points
  geom_point(data = filter(df_master, !is_sig_interaction), 
             color = "grey85", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  # Significant interaction points colored by Category
  geom_point(data = sig_interaction_df, 
             aes(color = Category), alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cat_colors_present, name = "Interaction Mode") +
  
  # Reference lines (1:1 line = no interaction effect)
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  
  labs(
    title   = "Panel B: Drought LFC Comparison (AMF vs. Non-AMF)",
    x       = expression("Log"[2]*"FC Drought effect in Non-AMF"),
    y       = expression("Log"[2]*"FC Drought effect in AMF"),
    caption = "Dashed line (y = x) represents identical drought response (No Interaction)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")

print(panel_B)


# ==============================================================================
# PANEL C: EXPRESSION HEATMAP (460 INTERACTION DEGs)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Normalize & Z-score scaled counts
norm_counts      <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
sig_genes_counts <- norm_counts[sig_interaction_df$gene, ]
z_scores         <- t(scale(t(sig_genes_counts)))

# 2. Build row/col annotation structures
annotation_row <- data.frame(
  Category  = factor(sig_interaction_df$Category, levels = present_categories),
  row.names = sig_interaction_df$gene
)

annotation_col <- as.data.frame(colData(dds)[, c("Myco", "Irrigation")])

# 3. Generate Heatmap
panel_C <- pheatmap(
  z_scores,
  annotation_row    = annotation_row,
  annotation_col    = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = list(Category = cat_colors_present), 
  show_rownames     = FALSE,
  show_colnames     = TRUE,
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  cluster_cols      = FALSE,
  scale             = "none",
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu")))(100),
  main              = "Panel C: Expression Patterns of 460 Interaction DEGs Across All 4 Conditions",
  cutree_rows       = length(present_categories) # Dynamically split by number of present categories
)

# 4. Print Summary Count Table
table(annotation_row$Category)

interaction_Genes<-z_scores

```


# 7. Gene annotation

### Gene products


```{r 18 Annotategenes,echo =TRUE}

# import annotation

  GFF<- read.delim("/Users/im/Documents/UniFR/2024_FRIBURG2/02_2024_ArganGenome/03_Manuscript_v6/04_Annotation/01_hap1/Sspinosum_hap1.gtf",header = F,sep = "\t",comment.char = "#",)

# modify annotation gene name

a<-lapply(strsplit(GFF$V9,split =";") , function(x)  paste(x[grep("Name=",x)],x[length(x)],sep = "@") )  
b<-lapply(strsplit(GFF$V9,split =";") , function(x)  x[1]   )

c2<- as.data.frame(matrix(unlist(Map(c,a,b)),ncol = 2,byrow = T))
c3<-gsub("transcript_id ","",unlist(lapply(strsplit(c2$V1,split = "@"), function (x) x[[1]]))  )
c3[c3==""]<-gsub("gene_id","",c2$V1[grep("Name",invert = T,c2$V1)] )
c2$V1<-c3
c2$V2<-gsub("transcript_id ","",c2$V2)
c2$V1<-gsub("@","",c2$V1)

GFFb<-cbind.data.frame(GFF,Geneid=c2$V2,Name=c2$V1)


# Grep gene region
gffID<-unlist(lapply(strsplit(GFFb[GFFb$V3=="mRNA",9],split =";"),function (x) x[c(2)]) )
gffID<-gsub("gene_id ","",gffID)
gffProduct<-unlist(lapply(strsplit(GFFb[GFFb$V3=="mRNA",9],split =";"),function (x) x[c(8)]) )
gffProduct<-gsub("product=","",gffProduct)
gfffaa<-unlist(lapply(strsplit(GFFb[GFFb$V3=="mRNA",9],split =";"),function (x) x[c(1)]) )
gfffaa<-gsub("transcript_id ","",gfffaa)


gffAnno<-cbind.data.frame(Geneid=gffID,Product=gffProduct,ID=gfffaa)
gffAnno<-gffAnno[!duplicated(gffAnno$Geneid), ]
```

# 7. TOP GENES per Test

## 1. Drought effect Non-mycorrhiza

```{r top Genes,echo =TRUE}
#top 5 %
# 1. Identify the top 5% threshold for padj
# We use quantile to find the value that marks the bottom 5% of p-values
threshold <- quantile(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF$padj, probs = 0.005, na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Filter the results to get the gene IDs
top_genes_indices <- which(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF$padj <= threshold)
top_genes_ids <- rownames(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF)[top_genes_indices]

# 3. Subset your expression matrix using these IDs
plot_mat <- vsd_mat[top_genes_ids, ]

colnames(plot_mat)<-gsub("20FC","Drought",gsub("80FC","Well-watered",paste(coldata$Myco,coldata$Irrigation,sep="_")))


tempName<-eggNOGNameVF[eggNOGNameVF$geneID %in% rownames(plot_mat),]
tempName2<-paste(tempName[,1],tempName[,2],sep = "_")

# Genes missing in annotation
missNAmes<-paste(rownames(plot_mat)[!rownames(plot_mat) %in% tempName$geneID],"NA",sep = "_")

# 1. Combine your two data sources into one vector
all_names <- c(tempName2, missNAmes)

# 2. Extract the prefix (the part before the underscore) to use as names
# This allows us to call all_names["g11631.t1"] and get the full string
names(all_names) <- sub("_.*", "", all_names)

# 3. Use the original rownames to pull the strings in the correct order
final_ordered_names <- all_names[rownames(plot_mat)]

# 4. (Optional) Remove the names attribute if you want a clean vector
final_ordered_names <- unname(final_ordered_names)
rownames(plot_mat) <- final_ordered_names

# 5. show only columns of comparions

plot_mat<-plot_mat[,grep("^AMF",colnames(plot_mat),invert = T)]

# 6. Generate the heatmap



pheatmap(t(plot_mat), 
         scale = "column", 
         show_colnames = TRUE, 
         show_rownames = TRUE, # Hide if there are too many genes to read
         main = "Water-status, non-mycorrhizal\nTop 0.5% Significant Genes (by padj)",
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation")



```

# 8. GO ENrichement analysis 

### 1. ALL drought genes


```{r 202 GO drought,echo =TRUE}


# import eggNOG annotation. create an object with gene name as list name and Go terms inside each list element as a vector.

#Genes of interest

row.names(sig_AMF_at_20FC)
  geneList <- factor(as.integer(eggNOG4$geneID %in% gsub("gene-","",genes_Irrigation))) #define which genes 
names(geneList) <- eggNOG4$geneID
str(geneList)

# create data object
GOdata <- new("topGOdata", ontology = "BP", allGenes = geneList, annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = eggNOG4b, nodeSize = 10)

#perform test
resultFisher <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "classic", statistic = "fisher")


# viz test only fisher

allGO = usedGO(object = GOdata)
allResR4 <- GenTable(GOdata, classicFisher = resultFisher, ranksOf = "classicFisher", topNodes = length(allGO))
GO_AMFEffect_Drought<-allResR4

allResR4Sign<-allResR4[allResR4$classicFisher<0.05,]
showSigOfNodes(GOdata, score(resultFisher), firstSigNodes = 5, useInfo = 'all')


printGraph(GOdata, resultFisher, firstSigNodes = 5, fn.prefix = "EffectAMFArgane", useInfo = "all", pdfSW = TRUE)


write.table(allResR4Sign
, "/Users/im/Documents/UniFR/2024_FRIBURG2/03_2024_RNAseqDrought/Results/GOvf_enriched_ALL_DROUGHT.tsv",quote = F,sep = "\t",row.names = T)
```

### pheatmap different go terms by hypothesis  Dorught Effect
```{r 210 GO 4 hypothesis Drought effect,echo =TRUE}

# Irrigation effect
SumIrrigationEffect<-merge(GO_IrrigationEffect_NOAMF[,c(1,2,6)],GO_IrrigationEffect_AMF[,c(1,6)],by="GO.ID")
# modify format
colnames(SumIrrigationEffect)<-c("GO.ID","Term","IrrigationNOAMF","IrrigationAMF")
SumIrrigationEffect$IrrigationNOAMF<-as.numeric(SumIrrigationEffect$IrrigationNOAMF)
SumIrrigationEffect$IrrigationAMF<-as.numeric(SumIrrigationEffect$IrrigationAMF)
rownames(SumIrrigationEffect)<-SumIrrigationEffect$GO.ID

# filter only a significant value in a column
SumIrrigationEffect_filtered <- SumIrrigationEffect[apply(SumIrrigationEffect < 0.05, 1, any), ]

#significant in both
SumIrrigationEffect_filtered[SumIrrigationEffect_filtered$IrrigationNOAMF<0.05 & SumIrrigationEffect_filtered$IrrigationAMF<0.05,]
#significant when no AMF
SumIrrigationEffect_filtered[SumIrrigationEffect_filtered$IrrigationNOAMF<0.05 & SumIrrigationEffect_filtered$IrrigationAMF>0.05,]
#significant when AMF
SumIrrigationEffect_filtered[SumIrrigationEffect_filtered$IrrigationNOAMF>0.05 & SumIrrigationEffect_filtered$IrrigationAMF<0.05,]

# figure
my_colors <- c("darkgreen", "gray")
breaks <- c(0, 0.05, 1)
pheatmap(SumIrrigationEffect_filtered[,3:4],color = my_colors,breaks = breaks)
```

```{r 23 Expression Myc genes,echo =TRUE}
padj2 <- DroughtMycGenes[rownames(DroughtMycGenes), "padj"]

stars <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(PheatMycGenes), ncol = ncol(PheatMycGenes))
colnames(stars) <- colnames(PheatMycGenes)
rownames(stars) <- rownames(PheatMycGenes)

stars[, "WellWatered"] <- getStars(padj1)
stars[, "Drought"]     <- getStars(padj2)
```

# 10. Expression of Mycorrhizal genes Rich Dataset
```{r 23 Expression Myc genes Rich,echo =TRUE}

Rich<-read_excel("/Users/im/Documents/UniFR/2024_FRIBURG2/03_2024_RNAseqDrought/03_AMF_Markers/05_Rich_MycGenes/BesthitRich_Hap1.xlsx", sheet = "HomologsVF")

#list of myc genes
MycGenes<-Rich
#mycEffec wellWatered plants
WWMycGenes<-res_AMF_at_80FC[rownames(res_AMF_at_80FC)%in%MycGenes$ID,]
#myc effect dorught plants
DroughtMycGenes<-res_AMF_at_20FC[rownames(res_AMF_at_20FC)%in%MycGenes$ID,]
PheatMycGenes<-cbind.data.frame(WellWatered=(WWMycGenes$log2FoldChange),Drought=DroughtMycGenes$log2FoldChange)
rownames(PheatMycGenes)<-paste(MycGenes$Name[match(rownames(WWMycGenes), MycGenes$ID)],rownames(WWMycGenes),sep = "_")

PheatMycGenes<- PheatMycGenes[match(paste(MycGenes$Name,MycGenes$ID,sep="_"), rownames(PheatMycGenes)), ]
PheatMycGenes<-na.omit(PheatMycGenes)


heatmap_IDs <- sub(".*_", "", rownames(PheatMycGenes))

# 2. Extract padj values in the EXACT order of the heatmap
# We use heatmap_IDs to 'look up' the values in the original tables
padj_WW      <- WWMycGenes[heatmap_IDs, "padj"]
padj_Drought <- DroughtMycGenes[heatmap_IDs, "padj"]

# 3. Create and fill the stars matrix
getStars <- function(p) { 
  ifelse(is.na(p), "", 
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", 
  ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""))))
}

stars <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(PheatMycGenes), ncol = ncol(PheatMycGenes))
colnames(stars) <- colnames(PheatMycGenes)
rownames(stars) <- rownames(PheatMycGenes)

# Now these assignments are perfectly aligned
stars[, "WellWatered"] <- getStars(padj_WW)
stars[, "Drought"]     <- getStars(padj_Drought)

#add £Hap2 PT4
PT4Hap2Stars<-data.frame(WellWatered=c("***","***"),Drought=c("***","***"))
rownames(PT4Hap2Stars)<-c("PT4_g170.t1*","PT4_g171.t1*")
```

# 11. Expression of Drough genes
```{r 24 Expression Drough genes,echo =TRUE}


DroughtGenes <- read_xlsx("/Users/im/Documents/UniFR/2024_FRIBURG2/03_2024_RNAseqDrought/04_Drought_Markers/02_OMA_orthologs/Orthologs_Argan_Athaliana_DroughtStrategies.xlsx",sheet = "OrthologArgan",)

# Drought effect on Non-mycorrhizal plants
#mycEffec wellWatered plants
NonAMFDroughtGenesGenes<-res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF[rownames(res_Irrigation_in_NoAMF)%in%DroughtGenes$Argan,]
# Drought effect on Mycorrhizal plants
#myc effect dorught plants
AMFDroughtGenesGenes<-res_Irrigation_in_AMF[rownames(res_Irrigation_in_AMF)%in%DroughtGenes$Argan,]

PheatMycGenes<-cbind.data.frame(NonMycorrhizal=NonAMFDroughtGenesGenes$log2FoldChange,Mycorrhizal=AMFDroughtGenesGenes$log2FoldChange)
rownames(PheatMycGenes)<-paste(DroughtGenes$GeneName[match(rownames(NonAMFDroughtGenesGenes), DroughtGenes$Argan)],rownames(NonAMFDroughtGenesGenes),sep = "_")

# Extract padj for each gene in both datasets
padj1 <- NonAMFDroughtGenesGenes[unlist(lapply(strsplit(rownames(PheatMycGenes),"_"), function (x) x[[2]])), "padj"]
padj2 <- AMFDroughtGenesGenes[unlist(lapply(strsplit(rownames(PheatMycGenes),"_"), function (x) x[[2]])), "padj"]

getStars <- function(p) { ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""))))}

stars <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(PheatMycGenes), ncol = ncol(PheatMycGenes))
colnames(stars) <- colnames(PheatMycGenes)[1:2]
rownames(stars) <- rownames(PheatMycGenes)

stars[, "NonMycorrhizal"] <- getStars(padj1)
stars[, "Mycorrhizal"]     <- getStars(padj2)



pheatmap(PheatMycGenes[,1:2],cluster_cols = F,
         display_numbers = stars,
         number_color = "black")

DroughtGenes$pheatname<-paste(DroughtGenes$GeneName,DroughtGenes$Argan,sep = "_")
PheatMycGenes$pheatname<-rownames(PheatMycGenes)

PheatMycGenes_v2<-merge(PheatMycGenes,DroughtGenes,by="pheatname")
rownames(PheatMycGenes_v2)<-PheatMycGenes_v2$pheatname
pheatmap(PheatMycGenes_v2[,2:3],cluster_cols = F,
         display_numbers = stars,
         number_color = "black")

# 2. Sort the Data explicitly
# We filter for 'tolerance' first, then 'avoidance', then bind them.
# This ensures the specific order you requested.
df_sorted <- PheatMycGenes_v2 %>%
  arrange(factor(Strategy, levels = c("tolerance", "avoidance")))

# 3. Prepare the Numeric Matrix for Pheatmap
# Move gene names to rownames and remove text columns
heatmap_matrix <- df_sorted %>%
  dplyr::select(NonMycorrhizal, Mycorrhizal) %>%
  as.matrix()


# 4. Create the Annotation DataFrame (The side bar)
annotation_df <- data.frame(Strategy = df_sorted$Strategy)
rownames(annotation_df) <- rownames(df_sorted)

# Define specific colors (Optional, but looks professional)
ann_colors <- list(
  Strategy = c(tolerance = "#E41A1C", avoidance = "#377EB8")
)

# 5. Calculate the gap position (Optional)
# This finds the row number where the strategy changes from tolerance to avoidance
gap_row <- which(df_sorted$Strategy == "avoidance")[1] - 1

stars_sorted <- stars[rownames(df_sorted), ]

# 6. Generate the Heatmap
pheatmap(df_sorted[,2:3],
         annotation_row = annotation_df,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         cluster_rows = FALSE,       # CRITICAL: Keep our sorted order
         cluster_cols = FALSE,       # Optional: Cluster columns if you want
         gaps_row = gap_row,         # Adds a white line between groups
         main = "Drought Response: Tolerance vs Avoidance",
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         display_numbers = stars_sorted,
         number_color = "black")



```


# 6. Differential Isoform Expression  Analysis

### Loading Count Data, Analysis on first Isoform

The raw gene count data is read from a tab-delimited file. The first five annotation columns are removed, and the column names are cleaned to extract meaningful sample identifiers.

```{r 100, echo=T}

counts <- read.delim("/Users/im/Documents/UniFR/2024_FRIBURG2/03_2024_RNAseqDrought/01_FeatureCounts/FC_Hap1_ALL.txt", comment.char="#", row.names=1)
counts <- counts[ , -(1:5)]  # Remove annotation columns
colnames(counts) <- lapply(strsplit(colnames(counts),split = "_"), function (x) c(x[[1]]))

coldata <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(counts),
  Myco = c(rep("AMF",6),rep("NoAMF",6)),
  Irrigation=c(rep("80FC",3),rep("20FC",3),rep("80FC",3),rep("20FC",3) )
  )

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ Myco*Irrigation)

## Filtering Low Counts
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 10, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds)

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)

res_Myco_at_20FC <- results(dds, contrast = c("Myco", "AMF", "NoAMF"))
res_Myco_at_20FC[order(res_Myco_at_20FC$padj), ]
sig_Myco_at_20FC <- subset(res_Myco_at_20FC, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 2)

#Store significant results in other than isoform t1
sig_Myco_at_20FC_Iso<-sig_Myco_at_20FC[grep("t1",rownames(sig_Myco_at_20FC),invert=T),]
gsub("t5","t1",gsub("t4","t1",gsub("t3","t1",gsub("t2","t1",rownames(sig_Myco_at_20FC_Iso)))))

res_Myco_at_20FC[rownames(res_Myco_at_20FC) %in% gsub("t5","t1",gsub("t4","t1",gsub("t3","t1",gsub("t2","t1",rownames(sig_Myco_at_20FC_Iso))))),]


IsosDE<-table(sub("\\.t[0-9]+$", "", rownames(sig_Myco_at_20FC)))  # DE isoforms per gene
IsosDE[IsosDE>1]
hist(IsosDE)
```
